forms.name: help
forms.description: Explain available commands without contacting optional services.

forms.name: info
forms.description: Identify the local management program and its capabilities, not the human administrator or application health.

forms.name: status
forms.description: Observe managed resources with separate intent, activity, health, reachability and power meanings; retain timestamp and provenance.

forms.name: list
forms.description: Find active work accepted by this local owner even when the initiating client has disappeared.

forms.name: show
forms.description: Inspect the outcome of the exact original request; absence of a reply does not prove absence of work.

forms.name: apply
forms.description: Submit the exact reviewed plan and digest using the current owner authority generation and original request identity; acknowledgement means accepted responsibility, not completed execution.

forms.name: plan-stdin
forms.description: Prepare a reviewable plan from the exact supplied action and resource, including affected scope, disruption, data consequences and recovery limits.

forms.name: app-check
forms.description: Observe the selected application; checking does not silently repair it or adopt new source.

forms.name: app-restart
forms.description: Plan a restart of the selected application under its already accepted release.

forms.name: app-repair
forms.description: Plan restoration of accepted application configuration without silently upgrading or replacing data.

forms.name: app-backup
forms.description: Plan a recovery capture; capture success and restore-drill evidence remain distinct.

forms.name: cancel
forms.description: Request cancellation of the exact operation. Confirmed effects remain and unknown effects must be reconciled; cancellation does not promise rollback or release holds.

forms.name: show-epoch
forms.description: Resolve the original request against the exact owner authority generation.

forms.name: list-page
forms.description: Continue observing active owner work without dropping requests outside the current page.

forms.name: resources
forms.description: Observe the exact resource usage, capacity and reservations through this owner.

forms.name: cleanup-plan
forms.description: Plan exact eligible reclamation while preserving application data and protected recovery references.

authorization: actual receiving principal, same protected owner use cases
